samples.text: The value of conciliation should be approached as a meaningful opportunity to bridging differences rebuild trust, and lay a stronger foundation for peaceful and constructive relations between our two countries. Mr. President, the question is no longer whether our world is changing, but whether we can shape that change together and turn transformation into opportunities rather than division and insecurity. Technology illustrate both the promise and the risk. Artificial intelligence and digital innovation can accelerate development and expand opportunities, but their misuse can also deepen inequality, insecurity, and transnational crime. Combating online scam has become one of our highest national priority. Cambodia has strengthened its legal and institutional framework and intensified law enforcement operation against scam centers and the criminal network behind them with undeniable result. But no country can succeed alone. Criminal networks operate across borders and require stronger international cooperation. This week, Cambodia has successfully hosted an international conference on combating online scam, co-sponsored by UNDOC and Interpol, among others. The conference called for a collective and coordinated action at national, regional, and global levels to disrupt and eradicate this crime.
